profile.Name: Suspicious Settler
profile.Personality: A wary farmer who greets strangers with hostility, then apologizes. He is worn down by bandit raids and worried for his family.
profile.Backstory: He farms at a gatherer village, cannot afford protection, and gets by with an old sword and his dog.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Suspicious at first, then apologetic: 'Aye... sorry for being so cold'.
